text:
To write you went day by day

beside the murmur, beside the continuous sea.

Promontories of shadow could not

disorient you or silence your voice.


Thus the powerful feelings

were justified, the actions,

discourses, the inextinguishable passion

will not die... You will live with them.


You will place in the matter of your craft

this final life, breath and meaning.

Human faith among the inert word,

human light in the immortal waiting.




1966

translation.title: To Write
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps writing as craft, breath, and human light inside inert words.
